purpose: Test whether a learned model of the system's own next-state dynamics improves held-out control compared with matched controls that do not use self-state prediction.
objective: keep energy near target 5 while minimizing action magnitude; reward = -abs(e_next-5) - 0.1*abs(a)

policies.self_model: fit linear next-state model e_next = beta0 + beta1*e + beta2*a from training trajectories; at each held-out step predict e_next for all actions and choose action maximizing predicted reward
policies.reactive: choose action using current observed e only with a fixed registered threshold controller; no learned self-dynamics model
policies.oracle: use true transition dynamics; positive control only

metrics.prediction_rmse: RMSE of one-step self-state prediction on held-out trajectories

interpretation_rule: PASS establishes only the registered operational property that a learned model of the system's own state dynamics improves held-out control. It does not establish consciousness, subjective self-awareness, general self-knowledge, intelligence, or universality.
